title: Testimony
summary: Halden can't touch Blackwater without proof. Their books are kept by an illager Sorcerer in a dark-forest hut. Take the ledger and put it in Halden's hands. Your name is in it too. That's the price of getting out.

goals.name: Blackwater Ledger

quest_book.title: Blackwater Ledger
quest_book.author: The Sorcerer
pages: Weekly takings: 3,000 emeralds. Tithe to the Chariot: one third.
New grower (see page 9). Promising. Watch him.

goals.say: There's your name on page nine. You take the book anyway.
Halden reads page nine, then closes the book. 'You'll testify. And then you'll be free.'
goals.name: Reeve Halden

talk: Reeve of Ashford. What's left of it. You're the one Mara writes about.
Everyone knows Old Mara. Nobody knows where she lives.
